  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Nanotechnology and Applications [PHY_4345]  
  Marks: 50                                                                                Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)            Derive an expression for density-of-states function using free electron theory of metals.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Describe the nanoscale materials and their classification.                                   (3)  
  C)       Are carbon nanotubes 1D, 2D, or 3D systems? justify your answer.                             (2)  
  2)            Sol gel method is a more significant method to produce nano metal oxide materials,  
  show it with neat diagram & explanations.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Explain differences between laser ablation and molecular beam epitaxy techniques in  
  terms of energy input, deposition control, and scalability.                                  (3)  
  
  C)       Predict what happens to particle size and surface area if the ball milling process duration  
  is increased. Justify your answer briefly                                                   (2)  
  
  3)            Apply the principles of optical spectroscopy on UV-Visible absorption and interpret the  
  band gap of the material with neat diagram.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Apply principle of photoluminescence spectroscopy to find suitability of materials for  
  LED applications.                                                                            (5)  
  
  4)            Apply the synthesis techniques of carbon nanotubes (CNTs) to propose a suitable  
  method for developing CNT-based sensors.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)       Relate the properties, and applications of nanocomposite metal-matrix fillers.               (5)  
  5)            Using your understanding of photo-catalysis, propose a nanomaterial-based method for (5)  
  wastewater treatment and assess how nano-scale properties improve catalytic efficiency.
